subject: Mobile Development
title: Google Play's Looser Rules
description: A fast breakdown of Google Play's Looser Rules for builders.

hook.text: Google Play has fewer rules than Apple's App Store. That's a feature and a problem.

buildup.text: Google uses automated scanning instead of human reviewers for most apps.

discovery.text: Apps get published in hours, not days. But malware slips through more often.

twist.text: Google Play Protect scans devices after install, catching threats Apple prevents at the gate.

climax.text: Google trades upfront control for speed and reach — a fundamentally different philosophy.

punchline.text: Google guards the house; Apple guards the door.

quiz.question: How does Google's review differ from Apple's?
options: Google mainly uses automated scanning, not human reviewers
